messages:
Priya Sharma: FYI — Stellarmind reached out. They want their 7B open model listed in AWS/GCP marketplaces and an optional HW bundle with our SI partner (EdgeWorks). Need licensing + redistribution terms, embargo window, and a go-to-market split.
Ben Cho: ack. Do they want hosted hosting too or just marketplace listing + downloads?
Priya Sharma: both. Hosted API by Redwood, plus a marketplace downloadable SKU (quantized weights) bundled with EdgeWorks appliances.
Marco Ruiz: technical flag — we need a compatibility matrix for quantized variants. EdgeWorks uses int8 on A100s and int4 on edge TPUs; model provider must sign off on those variants.
Emily Novak: marketing note — if we're bundled with HW, we should coordinate joint announcement cadence. Prefer soft announce to partners 2 weeks before public. Also want co-branded one-pager.
Tara Li: legal — initial concerns: redistribution rights for quantized weights, attribution, export controls, and a holdback clause for embargo breaches. We need provider to accept our standard marketplace addendum + a special redistribution appendix.
Priya Sharma: can you draft the appendix? Also want a suggested revenue split for marketplace sales vs hosted usage.
Ben Cho: suggested split: marketplace downloadable revenue 70/30 provider/Redwood, hardware bundle rev share negotiated with EdgeWorks (starting at 60/40). Hosted API usage to be standard usage billing to Redwood with model provider rev share for model-locked plans (proposal: 30% to provider). All negotiable.
PartnerOps: Created vendor ticket P-9876 and onboarding checklist. Assigned to @Ben Cho and @Marco Ruiz. ETA 5 business days. :white_check_mark:
Marco Ruiz: for onboarding checklist, adding required items:
```
- model weights (licensed)
- provenance metadata + checksum
- quantized variants + validation scripts
- runtime compatibility test cases
- sample prompts + eval suite
```
Priya Sharma: perfect. Emily — can you draft the co-branded one-pager template and embargo language?
Emily Novak: on it. Will share a draft in #marketing by EOD tomorrow.
Tara Li: legal ask to provider: confirm no third-party IP claims on weights and allow us to redistribute quantized weights under the appendix. Also: declare export-control jurisdiction and acceptable geoblocks.
Priya Sharma: Stellarmind asked about geoblocking EU vs APAC. We should default to allow EU, restrict sanctioned regions, and discuss APAC availability with Cloud partners.
Ben Cho: Ops question — does Dedicated / Private deployments need separate licensing? I'd say yes (enterprise/private: different contract, no redistribution).
Tara Li: correct. Private deployments — we only provide inference runtime; no redistribution of weights. Must be line-itemed in the contract.
LegalBot: Reminder: attach Marketplace Redistribution Appendix v2.3 and Standard Marketplace Addendum v1.8 to vendor packet.
Priya Sharma: next steps: 1) Tara to draft appendix + embargo clause, 2) Marco to produce compatibility checklist and test harness, 3) Ben to start commercial terms with Stellarmind (rev splits), 4) Emily to prepare co-branded one-pager and announcement cadence.
Ben Cho: I'll kick off commercial email today and propose a joint launch window in ~6 weeks.
PartnerOps: Updated P-9876 with tasks and due dates.
Priya Sharma: thanks team. Keep replies brief in thread — we'll do a sync if needed after docs land. :thumbsup:
